subject: Re: Discrepancy in OEM quote vs cloud capacity — proposed fallback lanes
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@acoris.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: OmniHealth Procurement <procure@omnihealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acoris OEM quote (v3) + leadtime note

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the call today. Please find attached the updated OEM quote (acoris_quote_v3.pdf). Two quick flags we want to call out up front:

- Lead time: current build queue indicates ~18 weeks from PO issuance to shipment for the proposed 4:1 density nodes. We can move some units forward with an expedite fee but that impacts pricing.
- SKU mix: we proposed an alternate lower-density board (3:1) that reduces per-unit model throughput by ~15% but shortens lead time by 4 weeks. Pricing is adjusted in the attachment.

We understand OmniHealth is pushing for an earlier onramp. If Redwood needs a capacity bridge, CloudReach (our channel partner) confirmed they can provide on-demand slices — we can share contact details.

Questions for you:
1) Can Redwood accept the 3:1 SKU tranche for the initial 30% of the order?
2) If not, are you formally requesting a short-term cloud backstop and for how long (weeks)?

We left comments in the quote on payment milestones and recommended Incoterms (DDP). Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Regards,
Amir Patel
Procurement Manager, Acoris Systems
attachments: acoris_quote_v3.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acoris.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, OmniHealth Procurement <procure@omnihealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acoris OEM quote (v3) + leadtime note

Amir — thanks and for the clear flags. Looping David and Karthik to scope negotiation levers and fallback design.

Short answers up front:
- We cannot accept a permanent 15% throughput delta for the full order; acceptable only as a temporary tranche if leadtime and pricing materially improve.
- We are formally asking for a cloud backstop to cover ~30% of the committed capacity for the first 8 weeks after contract start, then taper (detailed proposal below).

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Acoris: please provide a line-itemized revised quote that separates standard SKU pricing, 3:1 SKU pricing, and an explicit expedite surcharge (we want per-unit and per-shipment expedite numbers).
2) Acoris: confirm earliest possible partial shipment schedule (tranche sizes and ETA per tranche).
3) Internal: David — assess payment milestone options to offset expedite cost. Karthik — can you scope "cloud backstop" pricing/ops with CloudReach?

I attached a mutual action plan template (OMH_mutual_action_plan.docx) that OmniHealth prefers for milestones; we can adapt.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
attachments: OMH_mutual_action_plan.docx

From: CloudReach Sales <cloudreach-sales@cloudreach.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, OmniHealth Procurement <procure@omnihealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acoris OEM quote (v3) + leadtime note — temporary capacity offer

Hi Grace / OmniHealth,

Thanks for the heads up. We can provide a short-term reserved corridor to bridge ~30-40% of the GPU footprint with a 12-week availability window (private tenancy slices).

Highlights from our attached offer (cloudreach_capacity_offer.xlsx):
- Availability: capacity pool reserved within 5 business days of PO + signed addendum.
- Term: 12 weeks with option to extend in 4-week increments.
- Pricing: ~35% premium compared to committed OEM unit economics (line items in sheet); we can reduce premium if Redwood commits >40% of expected usage.
- SLA: 99.5% monthly availability for reserved slices; ingress/egress charges separate.

Operational notes: we require a short MSA addendum and a PO that references the reserved corridor. We can fast-track legal review if Redwood provides a copy of the mutual action plan and confirms billing owner.

If helpful, we can run a one-hour kickoff with David and Karthik tomorrow to map traffic routing and certificate exchange.

Best,
Nora Hayes
Director, Partnerships — CloudReach
attachments: cloudreach_capacity_offer.xlsx

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Amir Patel <procurement@acoris.com>
Cc: OmniHealth Procurement <procure@omnihealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acoris OEM quote (v3) + leadtime note — procurement perspective

Agree with Grace. A few pragmatic negotiation levers:

1) Split PO / Staggered shipments: Request Acoris to commit to a minimum first shipment (30% of nodes) at the 18-week ETA and a second tranche (50%) at 22 weeks; final 20% as contingency. This reduces our exposure and opens room for cloud backstop termination once the first tranche lands.

2) Expedite bucket: Ask for an explicit expedite pool priced per-unit and per-week. We only pay expedite if production slot confirmed within X days of PO. Helps tie payment to leadtime improvements.

3) Incoterms & customs: Push for DDP to reduce surprise OD costs. If Acoris resists, negotiate partial holdback tied to delivery performance.

4) Cloud fallback sizing: If CloudReach can guarantee 30-40% for 12 weeks at that premium, we should prepare a DocuSign PO for the bridge capacity. Legal + Finance: will need a billing owner and an appendix referencing the mutual action plan.

Owner assignments:
- Acoris revised quote: Amir (due EOD Thu 05/27)
- CloudReach signature-ready addendum: Nora (due Fri 05/28)
- Redwood legal to prepare DocuSign stub: Lauren Bishop (legal@redwood.com) — earliest by Wed 05/26
- Final decision point (internal): Fri 05/28 15:00 PT

I'll draft suggested payment milestone language and circulate.

-David
Head of Procurement Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <procurement@acoris.com>, Nora Hayes <cloudreach-sales@cloudreach.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: OmniHealth Procurement <procure@omnihealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 17:38:00 -0700
Subject: Final: action plan for quote reconciliation + cloud backstop (next steps)

Team — thanks for the rapid responses. This message summarizes the agreed immediate actions and owners so we have a single source of truth before we escalate to OmniHealth for signoff.

Summary decision: Redwood to pursue a hybrid approach — accept a staged OEM delivery cadence (30% / 50% / 20%) while contracting CloudReach for a 12-week reserved corridor covering 35% of committed capacity as a bridge. The CloudReach corridor will be executed only if Acoris cannot deliver the first tranche within 2 weeks of the 18-week ETA.

Action items and deadlines:
- Acoris (Amir): provide revised quote with separate line items for 3:1 SKU, expedite surcharge per-unit/week, and a tentative tranche shipment schedule. Deadline: EOD Thu 05/27.
- CloudReach (Nora): prepare a signature-ready addendum and price table for the 12-week corridor (we need DocuSign link). Deadline: Fri 05/28.
- Redwood Legal (Lauren): Draft DocuSign PO & appendix referencing OMH_mutual_action_plan.docx and the fallback activation conditions. Deadline: Wed 05/26 COB.
- Redwood Finance (David): Draft payment milestone language with a 10% holdback tied to tranche delivery performance; circulate by Thu 05/27 noon.
- Internal confirmation: Grace / Karthik to sign off on commercial tradeoffs by Fri 05/28 15:00 PT.

Risks called out:
- If Acoris accelerates only via expedited slots, total landed cost may exceed OEM baseline by ~18-25%; evaluate whether OmniHealth can accept a partial billing to cover expedite.
- CloudBridge cost is higher per-token; aim to minimize weeks on bridge.

Next sync: 30 minutes tomorrow 09:30 PT (Dave/Karthik/Nora/Amir/Grace) to validate the revised quote and the addendum. If anyone can't make it, please send updated docs beforehand.

Thanks — will forward this summary into the HubSpot deal record.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
attachments: acoris_quote_v3.pdf, cloudreach_capacity_offer.xlsx, OMH_mutual_action_plan.docx
